sentences: The tow truck reached the quarry road at a quarter past nine.
Juno parked behind the stalled van and set two flares on the gravel.
The driver of the van was a boy of about seventeen in a delivery shirt two sizes too big.
"It just died," he said. "Lights and everything."
She popped the hood and held her torch on the battery terminals.
The negative clamp was furred with white corrosion.
She scraped it with the back of a knife, wiggled the clamp and told him to try it.
The engine coughed twice and caught.
The boy laughed, a high startled laugh, and then looked embarrassed by it.
